name: Wands and Witches: Autumn Adventure
source:
Your character receives a letter at Hogwarts, after which he (or she) experiences a special adventure there.

This is a standalone project based on the resources of its main game Wands and Witches. Unlike the main version, this game is suitable for a teen audience. It contains two new quests, in addition, the main plot is redesigned.

[Edited from [url=https://greatchikenstudio.itch.io/waw-autumn-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的角色在霍格沃茨收到一封信，随后便在那里展开了一场特别的冒险。

本作利用正篇《Wands and Witches》的素材制作，是一个可独立游玩的项目。与正篇不同，本作适合青少年玩家，新增了两个任务，也重新设计了主线剧情。

[编译自[url=https://greatchikenstudio.itch.io/waw-autumn-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
